notes: Primary ask: Private VPC deployment for PHI-sensitive clinical agent + searchable medical record embeddings.
Audit logging requirements (detailed): SIEM export via syslog over TLS OR HTTPS POST with mTLS; support for both Splunk and QRadar ingestion patterns.

Log schema needs (fields requested): timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, correlation_id, user_id (hashed), tenant_id, model, model_version, prompt_hash, response_token_count, response_char_count, latency_ms, cpu_gpu_ms, routing_decision, fallback_reason, cache_hit (bool), kv_cache_id (if hit), route_path, region, vpc_endpoint_id, source_ip, user_agent, authenticated_subject, api_key_id.
Access logs: per-request access with signer identity, role assumed, STS session id, and policy reference. S3 artifact access must surface S3 request_id and bytes transferred.

Retention: Legal requires 7-year retention for audit logs (HIPAA/organizational policy). Must support immutable archiving (WORM) and export to customer-managed archive bucket in same region for residency.

KMS integration: Customer-managed CMK (AWS KMS) required for model artifacts + optional envelope-encryption of logs before export. Key usage must be visible in CloudTrail and included in audit export.
SIEM mapping: Redwood to provide canonical CSV + JSON schema and example messages; client will map fields to Splunk heavy forwarder. Preference for RFC5424 syslog framing where possible.
Performance constraints: Audit logging must not add >5ms p90 latency to token generation path; acceptable to batch non-critical debug logs asynchronously.

POC plan: 1) Provide log schema + ingestion samples; 2) Configure test VPC peering and SIEM pipeline; 3) Run 48h smoke with synthetic traffic and verify retention + immutability; 4) Security sign-off.
Quote from Security Director: 'We need per-request traceability back to the originating clinician and the model version — no black boxes.'
Preferred rollout: start with read-only embeddings indexing flows (lower latency sensitivity), then expand to live chat after canary and throughput validation.
Data residency: logs and encrypted archives must remain in-us-east-1; customer will request cross-account replication only after approval.
Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and KV cache to reduce overall token cost during POC and production.
Commercial note: Target ARR range acceptable; enterprise legal/procurement timeline is main schedule risk.
